## What this PR does

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Change to an existing skill (I bumped `metadata.version`)
- [ ] Tooling / docs

## Checklist

- [ ] The `validate` check below is green (it runs by itself on this PR; you do not need Python)
- [ ] Folder name equals `name` in the frontmatter
- [ ] `description` says what the skill does and when to use it (single line)
- [ ] `metadata.version` bumped for any change to an existing skill
- [ ] I wrote or have the right to share every file, and the license is one from the allow-list
- [ ] Scripts (if any) are small, readable, and do nothing surprising (no network, no hidden payloads)
- [ ] Text is in English or Russian (set `metadata.lang`)
